name: Shirudaku Settai Okawari Nihaime ~Inochi Mijikashi, Okaseyo Otome! Hen~
original_name: 汁だく接待 おかわり二杯目 ～命短し、犯せよ乙女!編～
source:
Nero Dokujima, a serial rapist.
A request comes in from viewers of an adult video produced by his accomplice—and indie adult video director—Naizou Nukeme: “We want to see girls in the Seika Aoi Girls’ Academy uniform appear in adult videos.”
“Seika Aoi Girls’ Academy?
Huh, a hakama-style uniform—that’s rare these days. Heh heh heh. Nice. That’s pretty tempting, isn’t it?”
Nero infiltrates the school—a “ladies’ school” with the atmosphere of a Taishō-era girls’ academy—
as a “janitor.”
All to prey on the well-bred young ladies in their hakama!


[Translated from the [url=http://www.waffle1999.com/game/26siru/00_siru_index_c.htm] official website[/url]]
